newsitem.title: UK: Air cargo trade Jan activity off 2.3pct-Tokyo-Mits.
newsitem.headline: Air cargo trade Jan activity off 2.3pct-Tokyo-Mits.

text.p: The index of U.S. air cargo trade activity dropped 2.3 percent in January, compared to a 1.9 percent increase in December, the Bank of Toyko-Mitsubishi said.

In its latest Foreign Trade survey of air freight carriers, seaports and trucking firms released here, the bank quoted one domestic-based air cargo company executive's observation that the strengthening in the dollar was helping to lift the pace of imports and slow exports.
The Bank's New York economic research department figures released Thursday, show the index of future U.S. air cargo business rose 1.2 percent to 534.4, compared to a 0.3 drop in December.
The January index of air cargo export business dropped 0.2 percent to 596.7, whilst that for import business rose 0.9 percent to 409.5.
Air cargo export expectations rose to 653.9 while import stood at 414.8 an increase of 2.0 percent.
The air cargo import diffusion index for January stood at 43.2 percent, which was considerably stronger than its year-ago January reading of 34.1 percent.
The air cargo current conditions export diffusion index for January stood at 36.4 percent, which was the lowest January reading since 1992.

The air cargo trade indices are equally weighted composite index of current export of import activity (not seasonally adjusted) with 1989=100. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
